status: draft by helper R (writeup, writeup-2); complete as far as the files of round 3 go. The final modelling pass (results-as-built/final/, 21:17-21:24) came after the fidelity review (FIDELITY-3.md last written 21:17) and has no review verdict. No revision 5 change was attacked. The fixes are designs; no script changed.
